papers.title_en: Adaptation of Computer Use Agents to New Software with User Manuals
papers.authors: Chulhoon Yoon, Kyungri Park, Jinyeong Yun, Daeyun Jeong, Sukmin Yun, Woohwan Jung
papers.evidence: 基于视觉观察与指令通过GUI操作软件的计算机使用智能体
papers.tldr: 面向新软件时，计算机使用智能体常因缺乏长程流程知识和应用特定操作模式而表现下降，且训练轨迹依赖昂贵人工标注。MAGE 将用户手册作为可扩展流程知识源：执行时检索相关手册并由规划器生成显式步骤，再通过环境交互适配策略以弥合手册与真实界面的差异。训练时将手册转成可执行任务-计划对，用计划引导环境 rollout 并优化策略，无需人工演示。六个应用实验显示任务成功率优于强基线，说明手册可同时支撑推理与训练。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have significantly improved the ability to operate real-world software through graphical user interfaces (GUIs) using visual observations and natural language instructions. However, maintaining strong performance on unseen applications remains challenging, as practical tasks often require long-horizon procedural knowledge and application-specific operation patterns. In addition, constructing executable tasks and collecting corresponding trajectories for training still heavily rely on human-annotated data, incurring substantial cost. In this paper, we propose MAGE (Manual-augmented computer use AGent Execution and learning), a framework that leverages user manuals as a scalable source of procedural knowledge to improve both inference and training. During execution, MAGE retrieves task-relevant manual content and uses a planner to generate explicit procedural guidance for CUAs. To further account for the discrepancies between manuals and actual GUI environments, such as version differences or user settings, MAGE also adapts the agent policy through environment interaction. During training, MAGE converts manuals into executable task-plan pairs and uses the plans to guide environment rollouts toward task-relevant states; the resulting trajectories are then used to optimize the policy without human-authored demonstrations. This unified design enables effective utilization of manuals for both task execution and training, reducing reliance on human-authored training data. Experimental results across six applications demonstrate improvements in task success rates over strong baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of manual-guided planning and policy adaptation in new software environments. We provide the code and reproduction scripts at https://github.com/ku-autoai/MAGE.

papers.title_en: Beyond Next-Screen Prediction: The Decision Value of GUI World Models
papers.authors: Sizhe Tang, Hanhan Zhou, Jeffrey Svajlenko, Rashmi Gangadharaiah
papers.evidence: 研究GUI世界模型与直接动作排序，用于界面动作选择中的候选动作评分
papers.tldr: GUI世界模型常通过预测候选动作的未来界面来提升动作选择，但增益可能来自评估器而非预测本身。作者用控制干预做归因，并提出不生成未来屏幕、直接学习候选排序的DAR。在匹配监督下，预测后继未带来可检测排序信号；DAR在AndroidWorld提升5.8–16.4点，并零样本迁移到未见应用。论文主张按决策价值评估GUI世界模型。
papers.abstract_en: GUI world models are increasingly used to improve action selection by predicting the consequences of candidate actions, but it is unclear how much of the resulting gain comes from prediction itself rather than from the evaluator that interprets those predictions. We study this attribution problem through controlled interventions on GUI action selection. With candidates and predictions held fixed, lookahead gains can change with how the prediction is presented to the evaluator, so end-to-end gains cannot be attributed to prediction alone. We then introduce Direct Action Ranking (DAR), which learns from reference actions to score candidates without generating future screens, and compare it with a prediction-augmented variant under matched supervision. Predicted successors add no detectable ranking signal once evaluation is learned directly. Without retraining, DAR improves AndroidWorld task success by 5.8--16.4 points across three proposers, outperforms world-model lookahead, and transfers zero-shot to unseen apps, where every prediction-conditioned configuration falls below proposer confidence. These results suggest that GUI world models should be evaluated by their decision value, the incremental action-selection value of their predictions beyond a strong direct evaluator, rather than by prediction fidelity or end-to-end lookahead gain alone.

papers.title_en: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhicheng Zheng, Cheng Zhang, Shengping Yu, Tianxiang Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向冻结视觉语言图形界面智能体的潜记忆与受控动作修正
papers.tldr: 冻结GUI智能体的潜记忆虽以历史补充为名，但其增益主要来自无范围动作修正，修复错误时会破坏8–13%原本正确决策。ScopeMem让前缀编码器以模型初始答案为条件，训练其只纠正错误并保留正确判断。受控消融中被破坏正确决策降至5.6%，修复错误数超过所有CE前缀。该方法在AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey和零样本AITW上优于提示与潜记忆基线，使冻结Qwen3-VL-8B追平或超过GUI专用智能体及Qwen3-VL-32B。
papers.abstract_en: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

papers.title_en: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Wang, Qianhui Wu, Haorui Wang, Simon Yu, Baolin Peng, Canwen Xu, Hao Cheng, Wenlin Yao, Boyi Liu, Yite Wang, Jianfeng Gao, Huaxiu Yao
papers.evidence: 为通用计算机使用智能体合成可控可执行环境
papers.tldr: 在真实计算机系统中扩展智能体交互学习既困难又有安全风险。WildAWM 提出可扩展流水线，合成同时支持图形界面、MCP 服务与命令行的可执行环境及长时任务，并用异构 rollout、交叉评判和反事实探针把关可解性、难度与验证可靠性。它完全由开源模型驱动，产出341个环境-任务对，前沿模型 GPT-6-Astra 仅解60%。仅在这些合成世界中训练 Qwen 模型，便在8个分布外基准上显著提升，说明合成环境可泛化到未见电脑使用任务。
papers.abstract_en: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

papers.title_en: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
papers.authors: Byeonghun Bang, Sangwoo Park, Jinheon Baek, Kangsan Kim, Youngwan Lee, Sung Ju Hwang
papers.evidence: 提出 ReTrace 评测框架，系统研究计算机使用智能体在长程任务中的失败恢复
papers.tldr: 计算机使用代理在长程任务中易受错误累积与意外副作用影响，但环境重置、动作回放和 API 回滚等恢复手段均受限。为此，作者提出 ReTrace 评估框架，形式化“转移一致性恢复”，并通过受控错误注入后的目标导向动作回放系统研究恢复行为。研究发现理想恢复能释放模型潜在任务完成能力，而现有代理未能充分利用该能力，准确恢复可带来可测的端到端收益。该工作将恢复确立为构建可靠计算机使用代理的基础能力。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery: identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal-oriented action replay following controlled error injection. Using ReTrace, we present the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery, revealing that (i) ideal recovery can unlock model's latent task completion capabilities, (ii) current computer-use agents fail to exploit their latent recovery capabilities, and (iii) accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains. Together, these findings establish recovery as a fundamental capability for building reliable computer-use agents. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE.

papers.authors: Saaket Agashe, Yuzhe Yang, Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Bhuvan Chandra Koduru, Chih-Lun Li, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
papers.evidence: 从任务经验中设计并演化交互界面的计算机使用智能体
papers.tldr: 计算机使用智能体的能力受限于人工设计的界面与使用知识，难以跟上新应用与新模型的节奏。作者提出让界面设计本身成为智能体能力，构建 Agent S4：元智能体分析任务轨迹，在无成功标签下自动构建并修订界面与用法知识库，再用基于种群的进化按验证集表现筛选可泛化的方案。在 OSWorld V2 上以 Qwen3.8-27B 达到 21.3% 二值得分，为固定界面同模型的 3.8 倍，超过 GPT-5.5 与 Claude Opus 4.8 且成本远低；ScienceBoard 成功率由 41.4% 升至 58.6%。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.

papers.title_en: Diagnosing Personalization Failures in Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Zhixin Lin, Dongliang Xu, Jungang Li, Shidong Pan, Jun Feng, Yanbin Sun, Jing Li, Liang Liu, Yue Yao
papers.evidence: 构建含1664个分阶段诊断探针的 PrefDiag-Bench，评测11个 GUI 智能体系统
papers.tldr: 个性化GUI智能体需按偏好调整执行策略并把握生效时机，现有基准只看任务成功率，难定位失败环节。论文提出PrefDiag-Bench，将偏好分为五类，用1664个探针按交互阶段追踪偏好何时生效及失败位置。评测11个系统显示非个性化任务完成率较高，但个性化任务明显下降，最佳模型在显式画像下Process偏好仅47.17%，Ranking与Process尤弱。受控补充相关证据可提升端到端成功率至多7.06%，为系统诊断个性化能力提供新基准。
papers.abstract_en: Unlike conventional GUI agents, personalized GUI agents require user preferences to guide sequential execution over changing GUI states. This raises two challenges: determining HOW each preference should alter execution strategy and WHEN it should take effect along the interaction trajectory. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate overall task success, offering limited insight into these questions. We introduce PrefDiag-Bench with two components: (1) a categorization of preferences into five types, characterizing HOW they affect execution; and (2) a stage-wise diagnostic framework with 1,664 probes, tracing WHEN preferences should take effect and where failures occur. We evaluate eleven GUI agent systems, including end-to-end agents and agentic workflows, under two forms of user context: explicit user profiles and behavioral memory logs. Although existing agents achieve relatively high completion rates on non-personalized tasks, performance is substantially lower on preference-personalized tasks. Even the best-performing model, Seed-2.0-Pro, achieves only 47.17% on Process preferences under explicit user profiles. Agents struggle particularly with Ranking and Process preferences. Further analysis reveals two key capability bottlenecks: selecting relevant evidence from user history and recognizing when preferences should take effect during execution. Controlled interventions that explicitly provide relevant evidence improve end-to-end task success by up to 7.06%. PrefDiag-Bench offers a more systematic evaluation of GUI agents' personalization capabilities beyond overall task success. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zhixin-L/PrefDiag-Bench.

papers.title_en: Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction Traces for Scalable GUI Agent Training
papers.authors: Zezhou Wang, Hanzhang Zhou, Panrong Tong, Quyu Kong, Pengxiang Li, Steven Hoi, Zhuzhong Qian, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 从交互轨迹重建可执行应用环境以支撑可扩展GUI强化学习
papers.tldr: GUI智能体强化学习需要保真环境，但由部分轨迹直接生成可运行模拟常导致状态转移错误。Trace2World将全局行为重建与具体实现分离：先把真实交互轨迹对齐为共享、可溯源的应用模型，再编译为可执行环境，并用源工作流独立回放定位偏差、限定修复。基于1570条轨迹构建50个环境，200个工作流端到端复现率达91.1%，显著高于基线59.8%；训练还带来基准与真机提升。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling GUI reinforcement learning requires environments that preserve real-app behavior. Yet coupling behavior inference with coding can turn partial traces into runnable mocks with incorrect state transitions. We introduce \textbf{Trace2World}, which separates global behavior reconstruction from implementation. It reconciles traces into a shared, source-linked app model, then compiles an executable environment. Independent replay of source workflows localizes mismatches for bounded implementation repair. Validated worlds then support learner-adaptive task and environment augmentation within source-supported behavior. From 1,570 traces, Trace2World constructs 50 environments. On 200 workflows across ten apps, 91.1% are reproduced end to end, versus 59.8% for the strongest matched task-local baseline. Source-grounded validation retains 94.0% of simulated training gains on real devices, versus 54.7% under self-validation. Learner guidance raises benchmark success from 56.9% to 61.1%. Training in Trace2World further improves the model by 20.2 points on our benchmark, 5.4--16.2 points across four external GUI benchmarks, and 16.3 points on 100 real-device tasks. Reliable reconstruction separates what behavior source evidence supports from whether the implementation preserves it.

papers.title_en: Subgoal-aware Memory Graph for GUI Agent
papers.authors: Dezhao Luo, Daniel Beechey, Derek Yuen, Weilin Luo
papers.evidence: 以子目标级记忆图提炼历史 GUI 轨迹，支撑长程移动端智能体决策
papers.tldr: GUI智能体要在长程任务中自动完成操作，仅依赖当前界面观测难以高效决策，需要复用历史经验。现有记忆方法要么存储单步动作，语义过细且不代表目标进展；要么存储完整轨迹，粒度过粗且难以跨任务迁移。本文提出子目标感知记忆图，将轨迹蒸馏为共享同一意图的连续动作，即子目标，并把相关经验组织成可合并、扩展和检索的图节点。在SPA-Bench上，该方法成功率较基线提升11.11%，说明以子目标粒度组织记忆能更好支撑GUI智能体的经验复用与决策。
papers.abstract_en: GUI agents aim to automate complex user tasks by interacting with mobile interfaces, but ef- fective decision-making in long-horizon set- tings requires reusing prior experience rather than relying solely on the environment ob- servations. Existing memory-based methods typically store experience either at the single- action level or as entire trajectories. Single- step actions are often too fine-grained to carry meaningful semantics, since the success of an individual action does not necessarily imply progress towards the overall goal. In contrast, whole trajectories are often too coarse-grained and difficult to reuse across different tasks. We propose a subgoal-aware memory graph that distils past trajectories into structured, reusable evidence at the level of subgoals. We define a subgoal as consecutive actions shar- ing a single intent, the granularity at which progress toward the task becomes meaning- ful. To reduce redundancy and support cross- task reuse, we organise subgoal experiences as nodes in a graph, where related memories can be merged, extended, and retrieved based on the environment observation. On SPA-Bench, our method improves success rate by 11.11% over the baseline.

papers.title_en: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
papers.authors: Bingyu Bai, Cheng Zhang, Erhu Feng
papers.evidence: 面向重复移动GUI控制的执行轨迹选择性复用
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体常重复执行相似任务，复用历史轨迹可降低LLM推理与执行开销，但指令和环境变化会使旧动作失效。该文将变化归纳为六类，并提出图-文本模板：图建模UI状态与动作转移，文本编码任务意图、流程结构与可变槽位。基于记录-模板-回放框架，系统按当前指令和实时界面逐转移复用、改写或丢弃。在AndroidWorld上平均降低约80%推理token，多数智能体提速至少1.5倍；真机Android/HarmonyOS动作复用率70.7%-79.8%，多数配置超2倍加速。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state. Based on this insight, we propose graph-text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record-template-replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse, adapt, or discard individual transitions. Given an execution trace, our framework reduces LLM inference token consumption by approximately 80% on average across five base agents on AndroidWorld, with most agents achieving at least 1.5-fold execution speedup over LLM-only execution. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7-79.8% while maintaining over 2-fold execution speedup in most evaluated configurations.

papers.title_en: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
papers.authors: Xinhao Song, Haoxuan Peng, Su Su, Hongliang Wu, Sirui Song, Gongshen Liu, Linfeng Zhang, Dongrui Liu
papers.evidence: 面向受保护界面的 GUI 智能体框架，分层完成感知、定位、求解、执行与验证
papers.tldr: 受验证码与反自动化机制保护的GUI环境中，仅给出正确答案不足以完成任务，智能体还需把求解结果转化为被接受的交互。SolveBind用分层求解树拆分Perceive、Ground、Solve、Act、Verify，并以运行时监督基于工具证据约束行动、按恢复预算调整执行。在九个验证码任务族和九个主干模型上，它在八个主干取得最高成功率，较最强基线高13.3-34.5个百分点。该工作强调证据约束的执行控制，也揭示恢复策略的成功率与成本权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points. It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

papers.title_en: AndroidFlux: Evaluating and Reward Modeling Failure Recovery Capabilities in Mobile Use Multimodal Agents
papers.authors: Gyubeum Lim, Yemo Koo, Ghunwoo Jang, Zsolt Kira
papers.evidence: 基于AndroidWorld的失败恢复基准，将轨迹回滚到检查点以评测移动多模态智能体
papers.tldr: 移动多模态智能体通常只从干净初始状态评测任务成功率，难以单独衡量其从中间错误中恢复的能力。为此，作者提出基于AndroidWorld的AndroidFlux失败恢复基准，将录制轨迹恢复到首个可恢复错误前、中、后的受控检查点，让不同智能体从相同设备状态与历史继续执行。该工作还构建奖励建模评测，并发布离线RL数据集以提升错误恢复和整体任务成功率。结果显示恢复表现与干净起点成功率仅部分相关，显式推理仅在经GUI领域特定RL训练的模型上有帮助。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile-use multimodal agents are typically evaluated by task success from a clean initial state, which does not isolate their ability to recover from intermediate errors. Because mobile environments change dynamically, a general mobile-use agent must complete tasks robustly even from unexpected states and in unseen environments. This requires knowing when and where an agent makes errors, and whether it can recover from errors and subsequent states. To evaluate this capability, we introduce AndroidFlux, a failure-recovery benchmark built on AndroidWorld. AndroidFlux restores recorded trajectories to controlled checkpoints before, at, and after the first recoverable error, so that different agents continue from the same device state and history. On these checkpoints, a complementary reward-modeling benchmark evaluates recovery-action preferences using downstream rollout outcomes. We further release an offline reinforcement learning (RL) dataset that improves both error recovery and overall task success. Our evaluations show that recovery performance only partially correlates with clean-start success, and that explicit reasoning helps only models trained with GUI-domain specific RL.

papers.title_en: Chart the Invisible: Interactive Perception for Hidden-Target Exploration in GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yongxiang Hu, Ruiyang Liu, Qining He, Xuan Wang, Yangfan Zhou
papers.evidence: 交互式感知，使GUI智能体能决定何时何地如何滑动以发现隐藏目标
papers.tldr: GUI 智能体受限于有限视口，许多任务目标需滑动才能显现，但智能体难以判断何时、何处、如何滑动，在需要滑动探索的场景中错误点击的比例达 47.8%。为此作者提出可滚动区域感知，并构建首个多模态感知模型 Hagasu，在 667 张人工标注界面上训练，用于动作选择前定位隐藏区域。Hagasu 正确识别 78.5% 的可滚动区域，在九个 GUI 智能体上把探索依赖任务的平均端到端完成率从 64.8% 提升到 82.7%，并开源数据集与代码。
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in command-line interface (CLI) tasks, recent LLM-based agents still struggle with reliable task execution through graphical user interfaces (GUIs). A key challenge is the limited content visible within a bounded viewport, especially on mobile devices, where many task-relevant targets remain hidden and can only be revealed through swipe interactions. Therefore, although most GUI agents support swipe as an action primitive, the lack of target visibility makes it difficult for them to decide when, where, and how to swipe to reveal the hidden content. Our quantitative study further shows that GUI agents incorrectly choose a click action in 47.8% of cases that require swipe exploration. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes equipping GUI agents with scrollable-region perception to support hidden-area exploration before action selection. To this end, we trained the first multimodal model for scrollable-region perception on a manually collected dataset of 667 UI screens, called Hagasu. By correctly identifying 78.5% of scrollable regions, experiments across nine GUI agents show that integrating Hagasu improves the mean end-to-end completion rate from 64.8% to 82.7% on explore-dependent tasks. To facilitate follow-up research, we release the swipe dataset and the source code of Hagasu.

papers.title_en: Right Click, Wrong Box: Grading GUI Grounding by What a Click Does
papers.authors: Xiaokang Yuan, Binhui Yao, Luwei Yang, Ruimin Chen, Zeng Wang
papers.evidence: 以执行结果而非标注框评判点击的 GUI 定位评测协议
papers.tldr: GUI grounding 基准只把落在单一标注框内的点击判对，但同一操作常可由多个元素完成，导致剩余错误被高估。作者改为按点击执行结果判对，用探针在真实网页执行并指纹化约千次点击，生成结果图与执行判官。在代码托管站和网店，框评分拒绝的点击约五分之一至三分之一仍达成目标；ScreenSpot-v2 盲审同样发现漏计，修正 0.2–1.8 分。该工作表明框评分系统性低估正确点击，应以结果等价性改进评测。
papers.abstract_en: Leading GUI grounders score 93 to 96% on ScreenSpot-v2, and reported gaps between new and prior models are about a point. At this level the useful question is what the remaining errors are. Benchmarks count a click as correct only inside one annotated box, but interfaces often expose one action through several elements: a duplicated link, the label of a checkbox, the title next to a logo. The box is not wrong. The rule is incomplete. We call a click correct when executing it produces the same outcome as clicking the annotated target. A probe that executes and fingerprints about a thousand clicks per page turns this definition into outcome maps and an execution judge for live web applications, with no new annotation. We execute the predictions of three strong 7--8B grounders on a code forge and an online shop. About one in five and one in three of the clicks that box scoring rejects reach the intended outcome, and the shares remain one in seven and one in three when the instructions are rewritten as natural tasks. A blind audit of 11 models on ScreenSpot-v2 (three 7--8B grounders and eight 3B variants) finds the same effect on web screenshots, with two independent reviewers on a 60-unit subset. The share is highest for the strongest grounders. Training seeds and test-set sampling add noise that more runs and paired intervals control. Box scoring instead under-counts correct clicks, which repetition does not remove, and the audit-based correction of 0.2 to 1.8 points on ScreenSpot-v2 is as large as the gaps the field reports. The correction is needed in evaluation. In our 3B GRPO study, crediting equivalent clicks in the reward gives no stable gain over box rewards across three seeds and four test sets. We release the probe, the outcome maps, the audit and every prediction.

papers.title_en: GUI-JEPA: Candidate-Conditioned JEPA Latents as a Fast Action Policy for Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Bingchao Wang, Yongcheng Jing, Shunyu Liu, Chengyu Wang, Jun Huang, Jie Yang, Wei Liu, Dacheng Tao
papers.evidence: 在JEPA潜空间中直接选择动作的无解码器GUI策略
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体通常用7B级VLM逐token生成动作，速度慢、显存占用高。GUI-JEPA提出首个基于JEPA的无解码器GUI动作策略：用无标注截图预训练的JEPA编码器把屏幕编码到潜空间，再由动作与区域条件化的潜变量预测器为每个候选动作生成一个潜变量，轻量头一次批量打分选出动作，全程不解码任何token。在AndroidControl上，同等GPU下比微调的Qwen2.5-VL-7B快2.8-4.0倍，仅用6%参数达到其分布内准确率的86-92%。该工作表明无需大VLM在环即可高效完成GUI动作决策。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents are typically fine-tuned 7B-scale vision-language models (VLMs) that generate each action as text. However, these VLMs decode every action token by token, and even agents that score candidate actions keep a large language model or VLM in the loop, making them slow and memory-hungry. To address these issues, we propose GUI-JEPA, to our knowledge the first decoder-free GUI agent policy built on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), which selects actions in the latent space of a JEPA encoder pretrained on unlabelled GUI screenshots. Its action- and region-conditioned latent predictor turns the screen latent into one latent per candidate action, letting lightweight heads score all candidates against the instruction in a single batched pass, without decoding a token. We further show that the scorer relies on this latent pathway and that the predictor is trained for the decision itself: a randomly initialised predictor does just as well as one pretrained on screen dynamics. On AndroidControl, GUI-JEPA is 2.8-4.0x faster on the same GPU than a Qwen2.5-VL-7B agent we fine-tune with the same inputs, while reaching 86-92% of its in-distribution accuracy with 6% of its parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/bcwang-sjtu/GUI-JEPA

papers.title_en: Learning to Look Beyond Screens: Transferable Visual Observation from GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Ruilin Yao, Xinyu Qiu, Tianyu Zou, Yi Rong, Shengwu Xiong, Shuheng Shen, Changhua Meng
papers.evidence: 利用界面定位轨迹与强化学习训练视觉语言模型的观察行为
papers.tldr: 视觉感知正从被动识别转向主动、任务导向的观察，但如何获得可迁移的空间监督仍是问题。LBS 以教师生成的 GUI grounding 轨迹做监督初始化，再用强化学习训练多轮裁剪与检查决策。在固定推理设置下，基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 与 Qwen3.8-27B 的模型均优于基线，且部分增益可迁移到 PerceptionBench、HR-Bench 和 ChartQAPro。结果表明 GUI grounding 可作为可扩展监督，支撑超越界面的主动视觉观察与多模态推理。
papers.abstract_en: Visual perception is evolving from passive recognition toward active, task-oriented observation. We investigate GUI grounding as a scalable source of spatial supervision for learning observation behaviors that transfer beyond interfaces. We introduce LBS (Look Beyond Screens), a vision-language model trained through supervised initialization on teacher-generated GUI grounding trajectories, followed by reinforcement learning for multi-turn crop-and-inspect decisions. Under fixed inference settings, LBS models based on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen3.8-27B consistently improve over their corresponding baselines. Gains beyond supervised fine-tuning transfer to PerceptionBench for both backbones and to HR-Bench and ChartQAPro for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, supporting observation strategies that generalize beyond GUI-specific imitation. Further analysis suggests complementary roles for the two stages: SFT establishes visual inspection primitives, while RL improves their downstream effectiveness. These findings support GUI grounding as a practical supervision paradigm for transferable active visual perception and broader multimodal reasoning. Our code and model are publicly available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/UI-Venus/tree/LBS and https://huggingface.co/inclusionAI/LBS-27B, respectively.

papers.title_en: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Ziyang Chen, Qian Li, Chengwei Qin
papers.evidence: 面向跨应用长程 GUI 智能体的任务推进记忆，从已验证进展中学习可复用操作
papers.tldr: 长程GUI任务中，记忆应保留动作结果并学习可复用操作，但失败尝试与跨应用信息交织使这很困难。论文提出任务推进记忆TAM，将任务推进定义为经验证的任务进展，并用推进状态改变剩余目标、用推进监督抽象产生局部验证结果的交互。MobileWorld仅GUI任务中，推进状态单独将成功率从12.0%升至28.2%；完整TAM相对最强基线提升17.6%，每解决任务token减少38.7%。
papers.abstract_en: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory (TAM), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.
